name: Sweet Spices
source:
[i]"Heya! How's your day? Oh... It's been weird lately huh? Yeah, it's always a bummer when everything is not what it seems or... it isn't up to your expectation. But don't cha worry, it's called life, a story that is everchanging where everyone has their own glorious chapters and darkest hour. The pacing is sometimes as fast as the season finale and sometimes as low as the filler episode. What you hafta do is... just need to keep reading, no matter how good or bad the paragraph is. Eventually... you will realize that this is all just a [b]sweet[/b] story.... with a bit of [b]spices[/b]" [/i]

[From [url=https://cheezychess.itch.io/sweetspices]Itch.io[/url]]
